prompt.en: Which of the Great Lakes is the largest fresh water lake in the world?
prompt.fr: Lequel des Grands Lacs est le plus grand lac d'eau douce du monde?

explanation.en: Lake Superior holds more fresh water than any other lake on earth. It is one of the Great Lakes, which lie between Ontario and the United States.
explanation.fr: Le lac Supérieur contient plus d'eau douce que tout autre lac de la planète. C'est l'un des Grands Lacs, qui se trouvent entre l'Ontario et les États-Unis.

source.quote: There are five Great Lakes located between Ontario and the United States: Lake Ontario, Lake Erie, Lake Huron, Lake Michigan (in the U.S.A.) and Lake Superior, the largest fresh water lake in the world.
